headline: legal-explainers rises 86 to 90; no-code-automation 83 to 86
paragraphs: Biggest score moves since yesterday: legal-explainers rose from 86 to 90 (38 channels, up from 36) and no-code-automation from 83 to 86 as its breakout rate went from 45% to 49%. travel-guides fell from 83 to 80; business-case-studies rose from 79 to 81.

In legal-explainers, 10 of the top 12 videos still come from Logic vs. Liability (1,790 subscribers). In travel-guides, 9 of the top 12 titles use Bengali, Urdu or Hindi script, so English demand looks thin. In robotics-humanoids the typical best outlier fell from 16.5x to 11.5x.

Notable outliers: Lore Explained's ancient-humans video at 3,629.7x (5,618,760 views, 12,200 subscribers) and GRENY's Egypt heat video at 2,738.8x (2,043,109 views, 3,180 subscribers). No niches added today. Thumbnails not viewable; titles only.
